findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_upload, get_account, apply_enterprise · Private data: create_upload, validate_pdf, create_order, get_order, cancel_order, get_account, apply_enterprise · Public sink: create_upload, apply_enterprise · Destructive: get_catalog.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_upload, get_account, apply_enterprise · Private data: create_upload, validate_pdf, create_order, get_order, cancel_order, get_account, apply_enterprise · Public sink: create_upload, apply_enterprise · Destructive: get_catalog

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
